name: Health Minister’s Discretionary Grant
benefit:
Financial assistance towards treatment in Government hospitals including super specialty Government hospitals / institutes.
Financial Assistance of ₹50,000/- if the estimated cost of treatment is up to ₹1,00,000/- .
Financial Assistance of ₹75,000/- if the estimated cost of treatment is above ₹1,00,000/- & up to ₹1,50,000/-.
Financial Assistance of ₹1,00,000/- if the estimated cost of treatment is
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must not be an employee of either Central or State Govt.
1. The applicant must have been Hospitalized / Undergoing Treatment in a Government Hospital (including super specialty Government hospitals / institutes).
1. The Total Annual Family Income of the applicant must not exceed ₹1,00,000/- per annum.
